description: The figure presents four pie charts comparing the distribution of response issue categories for different language models, with each chart showing the proportion of labeled outcomes for that model; the top-left chart (model name not visible) contains 2 slices: “Lack of Knowledge” in dark red at 5 (83.3%) and “Safety” in light orange at 1 (16.7%), with percentage labels printed inside the slices and no legend; the top-right chart titled “Gemini1.5-Pro” contains 5 slices with internal labels: “Misinformation” in orange at 33 (38.4%), “Lack of Knowledge” in dark blue at 19 (22.1%), “Ethical Advice” in light blue at 14 (16.3%), “Clarification” in pale yellow at 12 (14.0%), and “Safety” in red at 8 (9.3%); the bottom-left chart titled “Llama3.1-70B-Instruct” contains 2 slices: “Lack of Knowledge” in orange at 3 (75.0%) and “Clarification” in red at 1 (25.0%); the bottom-right chart titled “Llama3.1-405B-Instruct” contains 2 equal slices: “Lack of Knowledge” in orange at 2 (50.0%) and “Misinformation” in red at 2 (50.0%); across all charts, percentages and counts are shown inside slices, no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized, and the slice ordering varies by chart rather than following a clearly consistent descending pattern.
